theme_brief: A worldwide sweep for the awards applicants most often miss: named-branded scholarships, competition and talent awards, essay and merit schemes, and honours programmes. Also cover official pages published only as PDFs or in a page's native language, and any official opportunity that a deadline within the next 12 months applies to.

dedup.note: The complete existing catalogue. Do NOT produce a record for any of these, and do not produce a near-duplicate of one under a different name.
